title: Fractured Meridian
author: Hot-Cartoonist4428
selftext:
FRACTURED MERIDIAN is a T-rated first-person shooter trilogy built in Godot 4.6.3, set in the fractured world of Solenne — a once-unified nation split by catastrophe into a hyper-advanced Western paradise and a radiation-scarred Eastern wasteland. Players take on the role of Marcus Karev, a burned-out ex-Ghost Directorate operator, guided through the ruins by ARIA, a rogue AI communicating through his earpiece with motives all her own. The game launches with a free demo (Phases D1–D6) offering a full taste of the combat and story, before continuing into the paid campaign at $24.99, available on PC via Steam.

One world. Two realities.

One operator who knows where the bodies are buried.
